title: Verify: Zero-quota Send disabled and submit blocked unit tests
summary: Unit tests for disabled Send and blocked submit
description: Write unit tests from REQ2 with mocked client.
acceptance_criteria: submitContribution not called on form submit at 0 remaining
technical_constraints: Same mocks as VER1; fixtures from tests/fixtures/api.ts

steps.action: Add a describe block with three tests. (1) listMineMock resolves 5 distinct contributions; await the message, then assert screen.getByRole('button', {name: 'Send'}) has disabled true. (2) Same setup, type 'hello' via fireEvent.change on label 'Your idea', fireEvent.submit the form (closest('form') of the textarea), assert submitMock not called. (3) listMineMock resolves 4 contributions, submitMock resolves contributionFixture, type 'hello', click Send, assert submitMock called once with 'hello'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionQuota.test.tsx -t "zero-quota gating"
